Conversely, an outcome exceeding 106.9 would probably be driven by an equally impactful positive catalyst, such as an unexpected major breakthrough in relevant technology, a sudden and massive surge in demand, or a highly favorable policy announcement that significantly boosts the metric beyond typical projections. These "black swan" type events, by their nature, are difficult to anticipate but represent the extreme scenarios that could breach the bounds of the current probabilistic forecast.
